sources.summary: Oura announced its quarterly earnings today and said it agreed to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million, after adding the company's AI chatbot to its app earlier this year. Counsel Health calls itself an "AI-native primary care company," using the app to deliver AI-generated responses and insights based on users' health data reported from their […]
sources.summary_zh: Oura 於今天公佈季度財報，並表示在今年稍早在其應用程式中加入該公司的 AI 聊天機器人後，已同意以 6.25 億美元收購 Counsel Health。Counsel Health 自稱為一家「原生 AI 初級醫療公司」，透過該應用程式，根據使用者從 [...] 回報的健康資料，提供 AI 生成的回應與見解

sources.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 在賓士組裝試驗中金屬零件分類得分 96% / Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
sources.title_zh: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 在賓士組裝試驗中金屬零件分類得分 96%
sources.title_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
sources.title_original: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
sources.summary: Google Deepmind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a new control model for robots, and tested it with Apptronik on active Mercedes-Benz production lines in Hungary and Germany. The humanoid robot Apollo 2 sorted metal parts there with a reported success rate of 96 percent. The article Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 推出了 Gemini Robotics 2.5（一款全新的機器人控制模型），並與 Apptronik 在匈牙利和德國的活躍賓士生產線上進行了測試。人形機器人 Apollo 2 在那裡對金屬零件進行分類，據報成功率達 96%。
